ai: My grandparents love to reminisce about their school days.
我的祖父母很愛回憶他們的求學時光。
We sat on the porch and reminisced until it got dark.
我們坐在門廊上話舊，一直聊到天黑。

melodrama.zh: 通俗劇；誇張戲劇化的事件
ai: The old TV melodrama was full of tears and secret letters.
那部老電視通俗劇充滿了眼淚和秘密信件。
Stop turning a small mistake into a melodrama.
別再把一個小錯誤演成一齣大悲劇了。
This is the longest bridge I have ever crossed.
這是我走過最長的一座橋。
Who has the longest hair in your class?
你們班誰的頭髮最長？

rusted.zh: （使）生鏽（rust 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The old bicycle had rusted after years in the rain.
那輛舊腳踏車在雨中放了好幾年，已經生鏽了。
The gate rusted shut because nobody oiled it.
沒人上油，那扇門鏽死打不開了。

disillusioned.zh: 幻想破滅的；大失所望的
ai: She felt disillusioned after the company broke its promises.
公司食言之後，她大失所望。
Many disillusioned voters stayed home on election day.
許多感到失望的選民在投票日待在家裡。

unscrupulous.zh: 不擇手段的；肆無忌憚的
ai: An unscrupulous seller cheated the old man out of his savings.
一個不擇手段的賣家騙走了那位老人的積蓄。
Be careful of unscrupulous people who promise easy money.
要小心那些承諾輕鬆賺錢的無良之人。
The desk sits in a small alcove next to the window.
書桌放在窗邊的一個小凹室裡。
There is a statue in the alcove at the end of the hall.
走廊盡頭的壁龕裡有一座雕像。
Taiwan is a pluralistic society with many cultures and beliefs.
台灣是個擁有多種文化與信仰的多元社會。
The professor argued for a more pluralistic view of history.
教授主張用更多元的角度看待歷史。
I watched a rerun of my favorite show last night.
我昨晚看了最愛節目的重播。
The match turned into a rerun of last year's final.
這場比賽簡直是去年決賽的重演。
We had to rerun the test because the first result was wrong.
第一次的結果有誤，我們只好重新做一次測試。
The channel will rerun the series this summer.
這個頻道今年夏天會重播這部影集。
The new medicine was rigorously tested before it was approved.
這種新藥在核准前經過嚴格測試。
The coach rigorously follows the same training plan every week.
教練每週都嚴格遵守同一套訓練計畫。
The work was so monotonous that time seemed to stop.
這工作單調得讓人覺得時間彷彿靜止了。
He spoke in a monotonous voice, and half the class fell asleep.
他用單調的語調說話，全班有一半的人睡著了。

jot.zh: 匆匆記下（常用 jot down）
ai: Let me jot down your phone number before I forget.
讓我先記下你的電話號碼，免得忘記。
She jotted down a few ideas during the meeting.
她在會議中隨手記下了幾個想法。
There isn't a jot of truth in that rumor.
那個謠言裡一點真實性也沒有。
He didn't care one jot about what people thought.
他一點也不在乎別人怎麼想。
Many people believe in the sanctity of human life.
許多人相信生命是神聖不可侵犯的。
The monks asked visitors to respect the sanctity of the temple.
僧侶請訪客尊重寺廟的神聖。
After the injury, his strength was greatly diminished.
受傷之後，他的力氣大不如前。
The company's diminished profits worried the investors.
公司利潤縮減，讓投資人感到擔心。

keeping.zh: 保持；保留；繼續（keep 的現在分詞）
ai: She is keeping her promise to visit every Sunday.
她信守承諾，每個星期天都去探望。
Keeping a diary helps me remember what happened each day.
寫日記能幫我記住每天發生的事。
The documents are in the lawyer's keeping.
這些文件由律師保管。
I left my cat in my sister's keeping while I traveled.
我旅行期間把貓託給姊姊照顧。
The young singer enjoyed being in the limelight.
這位年輕歌手很享受成為眾人目光的焦點。
He tried to stay out of the limelight after the scandal.
醜聞之後，他盡量避開鎂光燈。

creeping.zh: 躡手躡腳地走；悄悄靠近（creep 的現在分詞）
ai: The cat was creeping toward the bird without a sound.
那隻貓悄悄地朝小鳥靠近，不發出一點聲音。
I saw him creeping down the stairs at midnight.
我看到他半夜躡手躡腳地走下樓梯。
A creeping fear slowly filled the room.
一股恐懼慢慢瀰漫整個房間。
Creeping prices are making daily life harder.
物價一點一滴地上漲，讓生活越來越吃力。
The shop hopes to recoup its losses by the end of the year.
這家店希望在年底前彌補虧損。
It took them three years to recoup the cost of the new machine.
他們花了三年才回收新機器的成本。
She has long, wavy hair that she never straightens.
她有一頭從不燙直的長波浪捲髮。
The child drew a wavy line across the page.
那孩子在紙上畫了一條彎彎的波浪線。
The army besieged the castle for several months.
軍隊圍攻那座城堡好幾個月。
Reporters besieged the actor as soon as he left the hotel.
那位演員一走出飯店就被記者團團圍住。

intractable.zh: 棘手的；難以處理的；倔強的
ai: Traffic in the city has become an intractable problem.
這座城市的交通已成為棘手的難題。
The old horse was so intractable that no one could ride it.
那匹老馬非常倔強，沒有人騎得動。
Don't muddle the papers; I put them in order.
別把文件弄亂了，我已經排好順序。
The long explanation only muddled the students more.
冗長的解釋只讓學生更加搞不清楚。
My schedule is in a muddle this week.
我這週的行程一團混亂。
He got himself into a muddle over the dates.
他在日期上搞得一團亂。
Rumors were rife in the office after the announcement.
公告之後，辦公室裡謠言四起。
The old building is rife with problems, from leaks to bad wiring.
這棟老建築問題叢生，從漏水到電線老舊都有。
If you persevere, you will eventually learn the language.
只要你堅持下去，終究能學會這門語言。
She persevered through years of hard training to win the race.
她熬過多年的辛苦訓練，最後贏得了比賽。
I found my old yearbook in a box in the attic.
我在閣樓的箱子裡找到了我以前的畢業紀念冊。
Everyone signed my yearbook on the last day of school.
最後一天上學時，大家都在我的畢業紀念冊上簽名。
The statistics office publishes a yearbook every December.
統計單位每年十二月出版一本年鑑。
You can find the population numbers in the city's yearbook.
你可以在這座城市的年鑑裡查到人口數字。
It rained intermittently throughout the afternoon.
整個下午雨斷斷續續地下著。
He has worked on the book intermittently for ten years.
他斷斷續續寫這本書已經十年了。
These cave paintings predate written language by thousands of years.
這些洞穴壁畫比文字的出現早了數千年。
The temple predates the city around it.
這座廟比周圍的城市還要古老。
The sign was crudely painted by hand.
這個招牌是用手粗糙地畫成的。
He crudely pushed past the people waiting in line.
他粗魯地擠過排隊的人群。
The movie contains a lot of profanity, so it isn't for kids.
這部電影有很多髒話，不適合小孩看。
Using profanity at work can get you in trouble.
在工作場合說髒話可能會惹上麻煩。
The priest was shocked by the profanity in the song.
神父對那首歌裡的褻瀆之詞感到震驚。
In some places, profanity against religion is against the law.
在某些地方，褻瀆宗教是違法的。
The children shouted with exuberance when the snow began to fall.
下雪時，孩子們興高采烈地大叫。
Her exuberance made everyone at the party smile.
她的熱情洋溢讓派對上的每個人都笑了。
I'm feeling unwell, so I'll stay home today.
我覺得不太舒服，今天要待在家。
He looked pale and unwell after the long flight.
長途飛行後，他看起來臉色蒼白、身體不適。
She spoke softly so she wouldn't wake the baby.
她輕聲說話，以免吵醒寶寶。
The manager spoke to us about the new schedule yesterday.
經理昨天跟我們談了新的時間表。
One spoke on my bicycle wheel is broken.
我腳踏車輪子上有一根輻條斷了。
The wheel has thirty-two spokes, and each one must be tight.
這個輪子有三十二根輻條，每一根都必須繃緊。
The two events seem completely unconnected.
這兩件事看起來完全沒有關聯。
The printer is unconnected, so nothing will print.
印表機沒有接上線，所以印不出任何東西。
Wheat bran is added to the bread for extra fiber.
麵包裡加了小麥麩皮來增加纖維。
He eats a bowl of bran cereal every morning.
他每天早上都吃一碗麩皮穀片。
The hospital has beds for two hundred inpatients.
這家醫院有兩百張住院病人的床位。
As an inpatient, she stayed in the ward for a week.
她以住院病人的身分在病房待了一週。
The team won a resounding victory in the final.
那支隊伍在決賽中取得壓倒性的勝利。
The speech ended with resounding applause from the audience.
演講在觀眾響亮的掌聲中結束。
My grandmother likes to embroider flowers on pillowcases.
我奶奶喜歡在枕頭套上繡花。
She will embroider your name on the bag for free.
她會免費在袋子上幫你繡上名字。
These gloves are made of natural latex.
這些手套是用天然乳膠做的。
Some people are allergic to latex.
有些人對乳膠過敏。
The town has a flourishing tourist business.
這個小鎮的觀光業十分繁榮。
She keeps a flourishing garden full of herbs.
她有一座長滿香草、生長茂盛的花園。
My father is a traditionalist who still writes letters by hand.
我爸爸是個守舊的人，現在還是親手寫信。
The traditionalists did not want to change the festival.
傳統主義者不想改變這個節慶。
That was the worst movie I have ever seen.
那是我看過最爛的電影。
This is the worst storm in ten years.
這是十年來最嚴重的暴風雨。
Our village was worst hit by the flood.
我們村子是受洪水災情最嚴重的地方。
Of all the players, he performed worst today.
在所有球員中，他今天表現得最差。
Hope for the best, but prepare for the worst.
抱最好的希望，但做最壞的打算。
The worst is over, and things are getting better.
最糟的時候已經過去，情況正在好轉。
The boy sang the treble part in the school choir.
那個男孩在學校合唱團唱高音部。
Turn up the treble if the music sounds too dull.
如果音樂聽起來太悶，就把高音調大一點。
The company hopes to treble its sales within two years.
公司希望在兩年內讓銷售額成長為三倍。
Prices trebled during the shortage.
短缺期間物價漲了三倍。
The rent was treble what we paid last year.
房租是我們去年付的三倍。
They offered a treble reward for any news of the lost dog.
他們為尋找走失的狗提供了三倍的賞金。

looking.zh: 看；尋找（look 的現在分詞）
ai: I am looking for my keys, but I can't find them.
我正在找我的鑰匙，但找不到。
She was looking out of the window when the bus arrived.
公車抵達時，她正望著窗外。

looking.zh: 看起來…的（常用於複合詞）
ai: He is a tall, good-looking man with a warm smile.
他是個高個子、長得好看、笑容溫暖的男人。
The strange-looking bird sat quietly on the fence.
那隻樣子奇特的鳥安靜地停在籬笆上。
The software can decode the video files on your phone.
這個軟體可以解碼你手機上的影片檔。
It took the team years to decode the ancient writing.
團隊花了好幾年才解讀出這種古老文字。
The kids snuggled up to their mother on the sofa.
孩子們在沙發上依偎著媽媽。
I like to snuggle under a warm blanket on cold nights.
寒冷的夜晚，我喜歡窩在暖暖的毯子底下。
The reservist returned to his job after a month of training.
那位後備軍人在受訓一個月後回到工作崗位。
Every reservist must report for duty once a year.
每位後備軍人每年都要報到服勤一次。
She had the foresight to save money for a rainy day.
她有先見之明，早早存錢以備不時之需。
A little foresight could have prevented this problem.
只要稍有遠見，這個問題本來是可以避免的。
The history class studied school desegregation in the United States.
歷史課研究了美國學校廢除種族隔離的過程。
Desegregation changed how many public places were run.
廢除隔離制度改變了許多公共場所的運作方式。
The old armoury in the castle now holds a small museum.
城堡裡的舊軍械庫現在是一座小型博物館。
Soldiers kept their weapons locked in the armoury.
士兵把武器鎖在軍械庫裡。

painstaking.zh: 一絲不苟的；煞費苦心的
ai: The restorers did painstaking work on the old painting.
修復師對這幅老畫做了極其細心的工作。
Writing a dictionary is a slow and painstaking job.
編字典是一件緩慢又需要耐心細緻的工作。
She dabbed her eyes with a tissue.
她用面紙輕拭眼睛。
Dab a little cream on the sore spot.
在疼痛的地方輕輕塗一點藥膏。
Add a dab of butter to the hot rice.
在熱騰騰的飯上加一小塊奶油。
He put a dab of glue on each corner of the card.
他在卡片的每個角上點了一點膠水。

leaving.zh: 離開；留下（leave 的現在分詞）
ai: We are leaving for the airport in ten minutes.
我們十分鐘後要出發去機場。
She is leaving a note for her roommate on the table.
她正在桌上留紙條給室友。
The professor's lecture was too esoteric for most of the students.
教授的課對大多數學生來說太深奧了。
He collects esoteric books that few people have heard of.
他收藏一些很少人聽過的冷門書籍。
The heat was tolerable once we sat in the shade.
一坐到陰涼處，這種熱度就還能忍受。
The food at the cafe was tolerable but nothing special.
那間咖啡館的食物還過得去，但沒什麼特別。
The river was teeming with fish in the spring.
春天時，河裡到處都是魚。
The market was teeming with shoppers on Saturday.
星期六的市場擠滿了購物的人。
A strident alarm woke everyone in the building.
刺耳的警報聲把整棟樓的人都吵醒了。
Her strident voice carried across the whole room.
她尖銳的嗓音傳遍了整個房間。
The report comprehensively covers the history of the city.
這份報告全面介紹了這座城市的歷史。
The team was comprehensively trained before the trip.
出發前，團隊接受了全面的訓練。
Tequila is made from a plant that grows in Mexico.
龍舌蘭酒是用一種生長在墨西哥的植物製成的。
He added lime juice and a little tequila to the drink.
他在飲料裡加了萊姆汁和一點龍舌蘭酒。
Watch out for the oncoming traffic when you cross the road.
過馬路時要小心迎面而來的車輛。
The driver's headlights blinded the oncoming cyclist.
司機的車燈照得迎面而來的單車騎士睜不開眼。
We are preparing for the oncoming winter.
我們正在為即將來臨的冬天做準備。
The farmers worried about the oncoming storm.
農夫們擔心即將來襲的暴風雨。
The shopkeeper was unfriendly and didn't even say hello.
那個店員態度冷淡，連招呼都沒打。
Some people think big cities are unfriendly places.
有些人覺得大城市是不太親切的地方。
The filament inside the old light bulb finally broke.
那個舊燈泡裡的燈絲終於斷了。
The spider spun a thin filament between the two branches.
蜘蛛在兩根樹枝間拉出一條細細的絲。
The rumor turned out to be completely unfounded.
事實證明那個謠言完全沒有根據。
Her fears were unfounded, and the test went well.
她的擔心是多餘的，考試考得很順利。

unchallenged.zh: 未受質疑的；無人挑戰的
ai: His claim went unchallenged because nobody knew the facts.
他的說法沒有受到質疑，因為沒人知道事實。
The champion held the title unchallenged for five years.
這位冠軍在五年內無人能挑戰他的頭銜。
The first snowfall of the year came in early December.
今年的第一場雪在十二月初降下。
Heavy snowfall closed the mountain road for two days.
大雪讓山路封閉了兩天。
By my reckoning, we should arrive before noon.
依我的估算，我們應該能在中午前抵達。
The old sailors used careful reckoning to find their way.
老水手靠仔細推算來找路。
The day of reckoning finally came for the dishonest manager.
那位不老實的經理終於迎來被清算的一天。
After years of waste, the company faced a reckoning.
多年浪費之後，公司面臨了總清算。
I love the crunchy skin on fried chicken.
我愛炸雞那酥脆的外皮。
Add some crunchy nuts to the salad.
在沙拉裡加一些脆脆的堅果。
The judge treated everyone justly.
法官公正地對待每一個人。
She was justly proud of what her students had done.
她為學生們的成就感到驕傲，這是理所當然的。
She put on some mascara before the interview.
她面試前刷了一點睫毛膏。
Waterproof mascara won't run if you cry.
防水睫毛膏就算哭了也不會暈開。
My boss is inflexible about work hours.
我的老闆在上班時間上毫不通融。
An inflexible plan can fail when things change.
死板的計畫在情況改變時可能會失敗。
The plastic was stiff and inflexible in the cold.
那塊塑膠在低溫下又硬又不能彎曲。
An inflexible rod can't bend around the corner.
一根不能彎的桿子無法繞過轉角。

eventuality.zh: 可能發生的事；意外情況
ai: We have a backup plan for every eventuality.
我們為各種可能發生的狀況都準備了備案。
The insurance covers the eventuality of a fire.
這份保險涵蓋了發生火災的情況。
He was a sickly child who often missed school.
他小時候體弱多病，常常請假不上學。
The plant looked sickly after weeks without sunlight.
那株植物幾週沒曬到太陽，看起來病懨懨的。
The kitchen floor was awash after the pipe burst.
水管爆裂後，廚房地板被水淹沒了。
The city is awash with tourists in summer.
夏天時這座城市到處都是遊客。
They sent a coded message that only the captain could read.
他們傳了一則只有隊長能解讀的加密訊息。
Each file is coded with a different color.
每個檔案都用不同的顏色編碼標示。
They will christen the baby at the church on Sunday.
他們星期天會在教堂為寶寶施洗並命名。
Fans christened the young player the new star of the team.
球迷把這位年輕球員稱為球隊的新星。
Several foreign dignitaries attended the opening ceremony.
幾位外國要人出席了開幕典禮。
The mayor welcomed the visiting dignitary at the airport.
市長在機場迎接來訪的貴賓。
After the failure, he decided to start afresh.
失敗之後，他決定重新開始。
Let's look at the problem afresh tomorrow morning.
我們明天早上用全新的角度再看一次這個問題吧。
The committee faced a weighty decision about the budget.
委員會面臨一個攸關預算的重大決定。
He spoke on weighty matters of law and justice.
他談論的是法律與正義這類嚴肅重大的議題。
The doctor's gloved hand held the small tool.
醫生戴著手套的手拿著那個小器具。
She waved a gloved hand from the train window.
她從火車窗口揮動戴著手套的手。
The teacher used an unorthodox method to explain math.
老師用一種不按常規的方法來講解數學。
His unorthodox style of painting surprised the critics.
他非傳統的繪畫風格讓評論家們驚訝。
Firefighters doused the flames with water.
消防員用水撲滅了火焰。
He doused the campfire before going to sleep.
他睡前把營火澆熄了。
The company decided to shelve the project for now.
公司決定暫時擱置這個專案。
They shelved their travel plans because of the budget.
他們因為預算問題擱置了旅行計畫。
Please shelve these books in the right order.
請把這些書依正確順序放上書架。
She shelved the cans in the pantry.
她把罐頭擺上儲藏室的架子。
Check the rota to see when you are working next week.
看一下值班表，確認你下週什麼時候上班。
We share the cleaning on a weekly rota.
我們按每週輪值表分擔打掃工作。

grinding.zh: 磨；磨碎（grind 的現在分詞）
ai: He is grinding coffee beans for breakfast.
他正在磨早餐要喝的咖啡豆。
The machine was grinding wheat into flour.
機器正把小麥磨成麵粉。
Many families live in grinding poverty.
許多家庭過著赤貧的生活。
The grinding work left him tired every night.
那份辛苦的工作讓他每晚都筋疲力盡。
Press the button to disengage the brake.
按下按鈕就能鬆開煞車。
She gently disengaged her hand from his grip.
她輕輕地把手從他的掌握中抽開。
The two armies agreed to disengage along the border.
兩軍同意沿著邊界撤離。
It is hard to disengage from work during the holidays.
假期間很難讓自己從工作中抽離。
A nail punctured the front tire of my bike.
一根釘子刺穿了我腳踏車的前輪胎。
Be careful not to puncture the plastic bag.
小心別把塑膠袋戳破。
I had a puncture on the way to work.
我上班途中爆胎了。
The nurse covered the small puncture with a bandage.
護理師用繃帶蓋住那個小小的針孔。

patronising.zh: 以居高臨下的態度對待（patronize 的現在分詞）
ai: Stop patronising me; I understand the rules perfectly well.
別再用那種高高在上的態度對我了，我完全懂規則。
She was accused of patronising her younger coworkers.
她被指責對年輕同事擺出居高臨下的態度。
We went on a safari in Kenya to see lions and elephants.
我們去肯亞參加野生動物之旅，看獅子和大象。
The safari guide showed us fresh tracks in the dust.
嚮導向我們展示了塵土上新留下的足跡。
She hushed the baby with a soft song.
她用輕柔的歌聲哄寶寶安靜下來。
The teacher hushed the class when the principal walked in.
校長走進來時，老師要全班安靜。
A hush fell over the crowd as the singer walked on stage.
歌手走上舞台時，群眾頓時安靜下來。
There was a deep hush in the library.
圖書館裡一片寂靜。
Hush! The baby is finally asleep.
噓！寶寶終於睡著了。
Hush, someone is coming.
噓，有人來了。
We ate a delicious Moroccan dish with lamb and dried fruit.
我們吃了一道加了羊肉和果乾的美味摩洛哥料理。
The shop sells Moroccan rugs in bright colors.
這家店販售色彩鮮豔的摩洛哥地毯。
A Moroccan sat next to me on the train.
火車上有一位摩洛哥人坐在我旁邊。
Many Moroccans speak both Arabic and French.
許多摩洛哥人會說阿拉伯語和法語。
She enthused about her trip to Japan for an hour.
她熱情洋溢地談了一個小時她的日本之旅。
Fans enthused over the new album online.
粉絲們在網路上對新專輯讚不絕口。
Multiple sclerosis affects the nervous system.
多發性硬化症會影響神經系統。
Doctors are studying new ways to treat sclerosis.
醫生正在研究治療硬化症的新方法。
The photo is too blurry to see anyone's face.
這張照片太模糊，看不清任何人的臉。
My vision gets blurry when I'm very tired.
我很累的時候視線會變得模糊。
The Sudanese city lies beside the Nile.
那座蘇丹城市就位在尼羅河畔。
She cooked a traditional Sudanese meal for her friends.
她為朋友做了一頓傳統的蘇丹料理。
The doctor is a Sudanese who studied in Egypt.
這位醫生是在埃及求學的蘇丹人。
Many Sudanese live in the capital, Khartoum.
許多蘇丹人住在首都喀土穆。
The baby slept soundly through the whole night.
寶寶整晚睡得很沉。
I always sleep soundly after a long walk.
走了很長的路之後，我總是睡得很熟。
Our team was soundly beaten in the final game.
我們隊在決賽中慘敗。
The plan was soundly rejected by the voters.
這項計畫遭到選民徹底否決。
The soup was lukewarm by the time I got home.
我到家時湯已經是溫溫的了。
Babies should be washed in lukewarm water.
嬰兒應該用溫水洗澡。
The audience gave a lukewarm response to the speech.
觀眾對這場演說反應冷淡。
He was lukewarm about moving to a new city.
他對搬到新城市興趣缺缺。
He is the namesake of his grandfather.
他和祖父同名。
The street is named after a poet, and the cafe is its namesake.
這條街以一位詩人命名，那間咖啡館也以同一個名字命名。
We discussed the appropriateness of the gift for a new boss.
我們討論了這份禮物送給新上司是否合適。
The judge questioned the appropriateness of his comments.
法官質疑他的言論是否得宜。
I screamed when I saw a cockroach in the kitchen.
我在廚房看到蟑螂時尖叫了起來。
Cockroaches can survive for a long time without food.
蟑螂可以很長時間不吃東西還存活。

reflected.zh: 反射；倒映（reflect 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The mountains were reflected in the calm lake.
群山倒映在平靜的湖面上。
Sunlight reflected off the glass building into my eyes.
陽光從玻璃大樓反射到我的眼睛裡。
The low scores reflected a lack of practice.
偏低的分數反映出練習不足。
His choice of words reflected how upset he was.
他的用詞反映出他有多難過。
She reflected on her mistakes and decided to change.
她反省自己的錯誤，並決定改變。
He reflected for a moment before answering.
他想了一會兒才回答。
The sight of the huge snake transfixed the children.
那條巨蛇的模樣讓孩子們愣在原地。
She stood transfixed by the beauty of the sunset.
她被夕陽的美景迷住，站著動也不動。
The writer was called a revisionist for challenging the old story.
這位作家因為質疑舊有的說法而被稱為修正主義者。
Revisionists argue that the traditional view is incomplete.
修正主義者主張傳統觀點並不完整。
The book offers a revisionist view of the war.
這本書提供了對這場戰爭的修正主義看法。
Revisionist historians reread many old documents.
修正主義的歷史學家重新研讀許多舊文件。

rationalise.zh: 為…找合理藉口；使合理化
ai: He tried to rationalise his bad habit by blaming stress.
他想把壞習慣怪到壓力上，替自己找藉口。
People often rationalise their mistakes afterwards.
人們事後常為自己的錯誤找理由開脫。

idyllic.zh: 田園詩般的；悠閒愜意的
ai: We spent an idyllic week in a small village by the sea.
我們在海邊的小村莊度過了愜意如詩的一週。
The farm looked idyllic in the soft morning light.
在柔和的晨光中，那座農場宛如田園畫。
He had no qualms about telling the truth.
他毫不猶豫地說出實情。
She felt a qualm of guilt as she took the last cookie.
她拿走最後一塊餅乾時有一絲愧疚。
Buttermilk gives these pancakes a light, soft texture.
酪乳讓這些鬆餅口感輕盈柔軟。
My grandmother used buttermilk in her biscuit recipe.
我奶奶的比司吉食譜裡用了酪乳。
The coach exhorted the players to keep trying.
教練力勸球員們持續努力。
The leaflet exhorts people to save water during the dry season.
這份傳單呼籲大家在乾旱季節節約用水。
Her parents immigrated to Canada in the 1990s.
她的父母在九〇年代移民到加拿大。
Many people immigrate in search of better jobs.
許多人為了尋找更好的工作而移民。
The clerk gave the enquirer a list of opening times.
店員給了詢問者一份營業時間表。
An enquirer called to ask about the price of the tickets.
有位詢問者打電話來問票價。
Social media gives news a feeling of immediacy.
社群媒體讓新聞帶有即時感。
The immediacy of the danger made everyone act fast.
危險迫在眉睫，讓每個人都迅速採取行動。
To his consternation, the door was locked.
令他驚慌的是，門被鎖上了。
The news caused great consternation among the workers.
這個消息在工人之間引起了極大的恐慌。
He has the strong physique of a swimmer.
他有游泳選手那樣結實的體格。
Her slim physique helps her run fast.
她纖瘦的體型有助於她跑得很快。
The defection of two players shocked the club.
兩名球員的跳槽叛離讓俱樂部大為震驚。
His defection to the other party surprised his friends.
他倒向另一個政黨，讓朋友們很意外。
It is scandalous that the repairs took so long.
修繕拖了這麼久真是太可恥了。
The newspaper printed a scandalous story about the mayor's spending.
報紙刊出一則關於市長花費的醜聞報導。
The film was rated for adults because of brief nudity.
這部電影因為有短暫的裸露鏡頭而被列為成人級。
Some museums post a sign about nudity in the art.
有些博物館會張貼告示說明展品中有裸體藝術。
Don't overload the truck, or it may break down.
別讓貨車超載，否則可能會拋錨。
Too many plugs can overload the electrical circuit.
插太多插頭可能會讓電路過載。
I feel information overload when I read the news all day.
整天看新聞讓我覺得資訊爆量。
A power overload caused the lights to go out.
電力過載造成燈光熄滅。
Each seat in the theater is numbered.
劇院裡的每個座位都有編號。
Please find the numbered box that matches your ticket.
請找出與你的票相符的編號箱子。
The singer won a Grammy for her first album.
那位歌手憑藉她的第一張專輯贏得葛萊美獎。
The Grammy is a music award given every year in the United States.
葛萊美獎是美國每年頒發的音樂獎項。

gratifying.zh: 令人滿足的；令人欣慰的
ai: It was gratifying to see my students pass the exam.
看到學生通過考試，我覺得很欣慰。
The team's success was a gratifying reward for months of work.
團隊的成功是對數個月努力的欣慰回報。
The obnoxious man talked loudly on the phone during the movie.
那個討人厭的男人在電影放映時大聲講電話。
Her obnoxious laugh annoyed everyone at the table.
她那令人反感的笑聲讓同桌的人都很煩。
There was deep mistrust between the two companies.
這兩家公司之間存在著深深的不信任。
He looked at the stranger with mistrust.
他帶著懷疑的眼神看著那個陌生人。
I mistrust people who promise too much.
我不信任那些承諾太多的人。
Many customers mistrusted the new app at first.
許多顧客起初並不信任這個新應用程式。
She accepted the inevitability of change.
她接受了改變是無可避免的事實。
The inevitability of the result made the game boring.
結果早已注定，讓比賽變得很無趣。
I need to recharge my phone before the trip.
出門旅行前我得先幫手機充電。
This battery takes two hours to recharge.
這顆電池要充兩個小時。
A quiet weekend at home helps me recharge.
在家安靜地過個週末，能讓我恢復精神。
She went to the beach to recharge her batteries.
她去海邊休息充電。
I am deeply indebted to my teacher for her help.
我非常感激老師的幫助。
We are indebted to our neighbors for looking after the house.
我們欠鄰居一份人情，他們幫忙照看了房子。
The company became heavily indebted after the failed project.
那個專案失敗後，公司負債累累。
They are indebted to the bank for the new house.
他們為了新房子欠銀行錢。
The kids got a bag of goodies at the party.
孩子們在派對上拿到一袋好吃的小零食。
Grandma packed some goodies for our trip.
奶奶為我們的旅行準備了一些好吃的點心。
Goody, we're having pizza tonight!
太棒了，今晚吃披薩！
Oh goody, the weekend is finally here.
哇，太好了，週末終於到了。
Drivers who flout the speed limit may lose their licenses.
公然無視速限的駕駛可能會被吊銷駕照。
He flouted the rules and entered the building without a pass.
他無視規定，沒有通行證就走進大樓。
He scrawled his name at the bottom of the page.
他在頁面底部潦草地簽下名字。
She scrawled a quick note and left it on the fridge.
她匆匆草寫了一張便條，貼在冰箱上。
I couldn't read the doctor's scrawl on the form.
我看不懂醫生寫在表格上的潦草字跡。
The note was just a messy scrawl in red ink.
那張紙條只是用紅墨水寫的一團潦草字。
In the old story, the sailors were flogged for breaking the rules.
在那個古老的故事裡，水手因違規而被鞭打。
He tried to flog his old bike at the market for a few dollars.
他想在市集上把舊腳踏車以幾塊錢賣掉。
Babies learn about the world through tactile experience.
嬰兒透過觸覺體驗來認識世界。
The museum has a tactile map for visitors who can't see.
博物館為看不見的訪客準備了可觸摸的地圖。
Many children in the region suffer from malnutrition.
這個地區許多孩子有營養不良的問題。
The program gives free meals to prevent malnutrition.
這個計畫提供免費餐點以預防營養不良。
The old fort was once a bastion against invaders.
那座古堡曾是抵禦入侵者的堡壘。
The library remains a bastion of free knowledge.
圖書館仍是自由知識的堡壘。

lieu.zh: 代替（用於 in lieu of）
ai: You may take a day off in lieu of overtime pay.
你可以請一天假來代替加班費。
He gave her flowers in lieu of a long apology.
他送她花來代替一長串道歉。
The rescuers threw a lifeline to the swimmer.
救難人員向游泳者拋出一條救生索。
The bus service is a lifeline for people in this remote village.
公車服務是這個偏遠村莊居民的生命線。
He seemed aloof, but he was just shy.
他看起來冷冷的，其實只是害羞。
She kept aloof from the office gossip.
她對辦公室八卦保持疏離。
The cat stood aloof while the other pets played.
其他寵物玩耍時，那隻貓獨自站得遠遠的。
He tried to stay aloof from the argument.
他試圖置身事外，不捲入那場爭吵。

received.zh: 收到；接到（receive 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: I received your email this morning.
我今天早上收到了你的電子郵件。
The students received their grades by mail.
學生們用郵寄收到了成績單。
The received wisdom is that breakfast is the most important meal.
普遍的看法是早餐最重要。
He challenged the received opinion about the old law.
他質疑大家對那項舊法律的普遍看法。
The city is a hub for emergent technologies.
這座城市是新興科技的重鎮。
An emergent pattern appeared in the data.
數據中浮現出一種新的模式。
The artist drew an oblique line across the page.
畫家在紙上畫了一條斜線。
The sun's oblique rays lit up the valley in the evening.
傍晚斜射的陽光照亮了山谷。
She made an oblique reference to his mistake.
她委婉地暗示了他的錯誤。
The minister gave an oblique answer instead of a direct yes or no.
部長沒有直接回答是或不是，而是給了迂迴的答案。
Many teenagers get acne on their faces.
許多青少年臉上會長青春痘。
She uses a gentle cleanser to help control her acne.
她用溫和的洗面乳來控制痘痘。
We go skating at the ice rink every winter.
我們每年冬天都去溜冰場滑冰。
Roller skating is a fun way to exercise outdoors.
直排輪溜冰是一種有趣的戶外運動方式。
The museum displays a piece of shrapnel from the war.
博物館展出一塊戰爭時留下的彈片。
Workers found shrapnel buried inside the old wall.
工人在老牆裡發現了埋著的彈片。
I dropped some shrapnel into the beggar's cup.
我把一些零錢丟進乞丐的杯子裡。
My pockets are full of shrapnel after shopping.
購物之後，我的口袋裡裝滿了零錢。

assumed.zh: 以為；假定（assume 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: I assumed you had already eaten dinner.
我以為你已經吃過晚餐了。
Everyone assumed the shop was closed because the lights were off.
大家都以為店關了，因為燈是暗的。
She assumed the role of team leader last month.
她上個月接任了組長的職務。
He assumed responsibility for the mistake.
他為這個錯誤承擔了責任。
The writer used an assumed name to protect her family.
那位作家為了保護家人而使用化名。
He traveled under an assumed identity.
他以假身分旅行。
Masking tape is useful for painting straight edges on a wall.
遮蓋膠帶在牆上畫出整齊的邊緣時很好用。
The loud music was masking the noise from the street.
大聲的音樂蓋過了街上的噪音。
The little boat was left adrift on the open sea.
那艘小船被丟在大海上漂流。
After the storm, the raft floated adrift for days.
暴風雨之後，木筏漂流了好幾天。
Without a plan, she felt adrift after graduation.
沒有計畫的她，在畢業後覺得茫然失措。
The ship was adrift with its engine broken.
那艘船引擎壞了，隨波漂流。
The shelter cares for abused animals.
這間收容所照顧受虐的動物。
The abused children were given a safe place to live.
那些受虐的孩子們得到一個安全的住處。

abused.zh: 虐待；濫用（abuse 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The manager abused his power to get what he wanted.
那位經理濫用權力來達到自己的目的。
She abused the free trial by signing up many times.
她多次註冊，濫用了免費試用。
The books on the uppermost shelf are hard to reach.
最上層書架上的書很難拿到。
Safety is uppermost in our minds when we plan a trip.
我們規劃旅行時，安全是最優先的考量。
Put the heavy box on the bottom with the light ones uppermost.
把重的箱子放在下面，輕的放在最上面。
The flag was placed with the red side uppermost.
旗子被放成紅色那一面朝上。
The fireworks lit up the sky spectacularly.
煙火壯觀地照亮了夜空。
The plan failed spectacularly, and everyone laughed.
這個計畫慘敗得很誇張，大家都笑了。
The thief targeted unsuspecting tourists in the crowd.
小偷鎖定人群中毫無戒心的觀光客下手。
The unsuspecting guests walked in to find a surprise party.
毫不知情的客人們走進來，發現是個驚喜派對。
She wore a dress with an embroidered collar.
她穿了一件有刺繡衣領的洋裝。
The embroidered pillowcases were a gift from my aunt.
那些繡花的枕頭套是我阿姨送的禮物。
Please don't misinterpret my words; I'm not angry.
請不要誤解我的話，我並沒有生氣。
The tourists misinterpreted the sign and went the wrong way.
遊客看錯了標示，走錯了方向。
Please affix a stamp to the envelope before mailing it.
寄出之前請在信封上貼好郵票。
The label was affixed to the box with tape.
標籤用膠帶貼在箱子上。
The word "unhappy" has the affix "un-" at the beginning.
unhappy 這個字開頭有詞綴 un-。
Learning common affixes can help you guess new words.
學會常見的詞綴能幫你猜出新單字的意思。

painstakingly.zh: 煞費苦心地；一絲不苟地
ai: He painstakingly copied every line of the old map.
他一絲不苟地描摹了舊地圖上的每一條線。
The team painstakingly cleaned each piece of the ancient pot.
團隊小心翼翼地清理那只古陶器的每一塊碎片。
She spoke with the calm that befits a leader.
她用一種與領導者身分相稱的沉穩語氣說話。
The party was held in a hall that befits such a grand occasion.
派對辦在一個適合這種盛大場合的大廳裡。
The doctor explained how the menstrual cycle works in health class.
醫生在健康教育課上解釋了月經週期如何運作。
Menstrual pain can be eased with rest and warmth.
經痛可以靠休息和保暖來緩解。
